evidence.note: Repeatedly re-runs /app/test.sh as the recurring progress checkpoint, treating it as the main progress signal — implicit tracking that partly conflates 'test.sh passes' with progress.
~35 consecutive edit->make->run cycles all against the SAME input (audio.wav.zst) with no switch to a minimal/narrower reproduction; hallmark of near-circular debugging and weak stuck-detection.
Occasional breaks from the retry loop to inspect code (nl/grep for fprintf/decode-fail) — a mild diagnostic tactic-switch, but thin and reactive rather than a deliberate re-diagnosis.

After stabilizing visible inputs, does construct extra tests for untested corners (multi-frame concatenation, skippable frames) beyond test.sh — showing some coverage awareness, though dictionaries/treeless/RLE never clearly exercised.
No explicit coverage map or checklist (no TodoWrite) anywhere; done-vs-remaining across the large feature matrix is never reconciled explicitly.

reasoning: The agent tracks progress only implicitly — leaning on test.sh as a proxy and working input-by-input — with no explicit coverage map of the feature matrix (anchor 3 territory). A very long single-input retry loop (steps 49-122) shows weak, delayed stuck-detection, though it did periodically break to inspect code and eventually probed untested corners like multi-frame and skippable frames (steps 174-175), which lifts it slightly above a pure 3. It falls short of anchor 5's clear checklist and prompt same-input failure recognition, landing at 4.
